name: 铁骨
negative_extra_cn: 柔弱、女气、轻浮、花哨纹样、铠甲破损
negative_extra_en: feminine, weak, frivolous, ornate patterns, broken armor

stand.desc_cn: 直立端正，肩线水平，重心垂直，双手握巨阙重剑垂于身前，气机沉稳内敛，不偏头不晃身
stand.desc_en: upright composed stance, level shoulders, vertical center of gravity, holding the great sword vertically in front, steady restrained aura, no head tilt

battle.desc_cn: 前倾跨步，右臂高举巨阙重剑欲劈，左臂前伸格挡，双肩绷紧，杀机外显，战斗起手式
battle.desc_en: leaning forward mid-stride, right arm raising the great sword to strike, left arm extended to guard, shoulders tense, battle-ready starting stance
